name: Agent Ownership & Accountability
description: Every deployed agent has a designated human owner accountable for its behavior, compliance posture, and incident response. Ownership resolves to a real, contactable individual.
threat_addressed: Unowned agents create accountability gaps. When an agent causes a compliance incident or security breach, no individual is responsible for response, remediation, or regulatory reporting.
enforcement_mechanism: Every deployed agent has a designated human owner recorded in the agent registry. The owner is a real, contactable individual (not a team alias or role), accountable for the agent's behavior, compliance posture, and incident response. Ownership confirmed within defined review cycle.

security_outcome.pass: Every active agent has a current, verified human owner. No orphaned agents. Ownership resolves to a real individual.
security_outcome.fail: Agent ownership or oversight responsibilities undefined.

display_detail: Validates that every agent has a designated human owner accountable for its behavior, compliance posture, and incident response.
remediation_hint_template: Agent owner not assigned or unverified. Add agent.owner in ancilis.yaml with a contactable individual accountable for this agent.
